import re, urllib.request, urllib.parse, time
BASE = "http://160.202.254.160:15880/"
PROXY = {"http": "http://127.0.0.1:12001", "https": "http://127.0.0.1:12001"}
op = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler(PROXY))

def post(content):
    data = urllib.parse.urlencode({"content": content}).encode()
    with op.open(BASE, data=data, timeout=20) as r:
        return r.read().decode("gb18030", "replace")

def echo_of(mark, content):
    body = post(content)
    i = body.find(mark)
    return body[i:i+300] if i >= 0 else None

chars = "<>/\"'()_=&;#:[]{}$%*+-.,!?@~^|\\`"
print("扫描字符:", chars)
for ch in chars:
    mark = "CH" + "%02x" % ord(ch) + "X"
    content = mark + ch + "END"
    e = echo_of(mark, content)
    if e is None:
        print("  %-3r -> (回显丢失)" % ch)
        continue
    seg = e[:len(mark)+8]
    changed = (ch not in e[:len(mark)+ len(ch)+3])
    print("  %-3r -> %-22r %s" % (ch, seg, "被转义" if changed else "原样"))
    time.sleep(0.05)
